##### Project general facts

The Gate 6 by Arada is a contemporary residential building designed for a dynamic and well-balanced urban lifestyle. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, with modern architecture and a strong focus on functionality. The collection offers stylish one-bedroom apartments and spacious two-, three- and four-bedroom family homes, thoughtfully planned to suit a variety of lifestyles, with selected residences featuring winter gardens that bring extra light and space into the living areas.

A swimming pool and a fully equipped gym support a healthy routine at home, while the building sits next to the main sports complex of the community, with football pitches, basketball courts, padel tennis and other recreational facilities. A lively boulevard offers an array of retail and dining options just steps from the entrance, and landscaped parks, entertainment venues and a thriving business district keep leisure and work conveniently within reach.

Residences are designed with modern living in mind, incorporating smart home technology and high-quality finishes throughout, while winter gardens in selected homes create a seamless connection with the balcony and bright, airy interiors. Kitchens are fitted with a premium European cooking range, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer, while modern finishes and high-quality materials create an elegant, practical backdrop for everyday life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture and decor entirely to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah whose layout draws inspiration from the historic districts of the emirate, blending heritage character with contemporary design. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with the Zad food truck park, a drive-in cinema, a large skate park, a gym and a trampoline centre, while the lively West Boulevard and the community sports park sit within walking distance of the building.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar and City Centre Al Zahia are a short drive away, University City and Sharjah International Airport are close by, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for daily commuters and frequent travellers.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the largest mixed-use destinations in Sharjah. Integrated schools, hotels, parks, a business district and extensive sports and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals alike. Accessible entry prices compared with Dubai and steady tenant demand support attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
